<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis for the target SMILES COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O, we can view the bicyclic core as the result of a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition. Breaking the two σ‑bonds formed in the forward Diels‑Alder gives a conjugated diene and a dienophile. A reasonable disconnection is cyclopentadiene (the diene) and methyl acrylate (the dienophile). Applying a Diels‑Alder retrosynthetic template yields the target from these two readily available precursors.</thought>
